answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in violet, expire in trellis, and hollow lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 158 aliases as a result needs 148 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 110 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
